{{Quote|The area we have designated "Sporefall" is perhaps the most fascinating of the three emerging ecosystems.|From "[[Initial observations of the Jannimak crash site on Dantooine]]", by [[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]], Disaster Response Lead for the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]|<ref name="Codex" />}}
"'''Sporefall'''" was an area designated by the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], located in the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> In that zone, the [[Jannimak]] discharged large volumes of an unclassified spore, to remarkable effect. The spores themselves mutated and multiplied at a rapid pace, causing rapid-growth in the native flora. Those with prolonged exposure to spores had side-effects including, but not limited to, sleepiness, nausea, disorientation,<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|Sporefall|exp=lots|type=codex}}</ref> severe hallucinations and depersonalization,<ref>{{TORcite|They Call me Doctor Spores|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> all of which hindered the research efforts. The spores were also triggering aggressive behavior in the native animals.<ref name="Codex" />

==GSI efforts==
The research team stationed in Sporefall was led by [[Edreck|Professor Edreck]], [[Deld|Dr. Deld]], [[Losoo|Dr. Losoo]], [[Lamuna|Dr. Lamuna]], [[Olobus|Dr. Olobus]], [[Armaxa|Dr. Armaxa]] and [[Spears|Dr. Spears]] accompanied by two researchers, [[Unidentified Human Sporefall researcher|one]] light-skinned male [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Unidentified Bothan Sporefall researcher|one]] male [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]].<ref name="Sporefall" />
[[File:SporefallForwardCamp-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|The Sporefall forward camp]]Their research was focused on observing relatively peaceful populations of animals affected by the spore exposure.<ref name="Pterathki" /><ref name="Makrin" /> Unlike in the other two areas of the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]], most of the creatures in Sporefall, even those known to be aggressive in the wild, did not show aggression towards the researchers,<ref name="Yara" /> and unique symbiotic relationships were noted between the species. While not sustainable in the long term, the spore-induced ecosystem proved to be a very fruitful ground for research.<ref name="fascinating" />
===Ship's response===
While the scientists, assisted by the contractors of the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], were collecting spore samples from the creatures, the ship's systems deployed [[Caretaker Probe droid|Caretaker droids]] to cultivate the [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] exposure in the air.<ref name="Sporefall" /> Poisonous side-effects of the spores were noted to alternate, suggesting that the [[Jannimak]]'s AI is conducting its own research into the effectiveness of various spores.<ref name="datapad2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Second Datapad "Progress Log: New Entry" found at the forward Sporefall camp om [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>[[File:SporeTending-SWTOR.png|thumb|[[Spore-Tending Unit]], an advanced series of [[Caretaker Probe droid|Caretaker droids]] utilized by the [[Jannimak]]'s AI]]

Until the research allowed the scientists to start manufacturing Anti-Microbal injections<ref name="spies" /> to combat the [[Fungus/Legends|spore]] poisoning, the fungi exposure significantly slowed down any attempts to further explore the area,<ref name="datapad2" /> including the entrance into the Sporefall side of Jannimak's wreckage. The first scientist to find and breach it was Doctor [[Spears]],<ref name="datapad1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|First Datapad "Progress Log: New Entry" found at the forward Sporefall camp om [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> whose prolonged exposure to the spores resulted in him developing a [[Multiple personality disorder|second personality]] and temporally siding with the [[Jannimak|ship]]'s droids in fighting off [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]].<ref name="SPORES">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Dynamic Encounter quest chain "Doctor SPORES" on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

===Czerka===
{{Quote|Wait a minute, those are Czerka frequencies! I don't care what they're doing - there's no way it's good.|Doctor [[Pordav]]|<ref name="spies" />}}
An armed [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] party infiltrated the adjacent to the Sporefall wing of the [[Jannimak]]'s wreckage, implanting surveillance devices. However, by the time [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors arrived to combat the intruders, Czerka personnel was already severely poisoned by the spore exposure, unable to escape the scene. Two [[Czerka tripod battledroid|Czerka battledroids]] that were with them got destroyed by the contractors, along with all the surveillance tech.<ref name="spies">{{TORcite|No Spies Allowed!|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sporefall first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> On the map it is marked by [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Besh/Legends|Besh]].<ref name="SWTORLofS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>
